error: 404: NOT_FOUND on Vercel after refreshing a page (Vite / React SPA)
meaning: Vercel serves your built files, but /settings is a client-side route with no file behind it, so a refresh or direct link returns Vercel's 404: NOT_FOUND page.
causes: A Vite/CRA single-page app was deployed without a rewrite to index.html.
Output directory set wrong, so even / is missing (Framework preset 'Other' with no dist).
vercel.json uses old routes syntax that conflicts with rewrites.

steps.text: Add vercel.json in the project root.
In Project Settings > Build & Development, set Framework Preset to Vite (Output Directory dist).
If you have serverless functions in /api, keep them working by excluding them.
Redeploy, then open a deep link in a private window to confirm.

prompt: My Vite React app deployed on Vercel returns 404: NOT_FOUND when I refresh any page except the home page. Add a vercel.json with a rewrite sending all non-/api paths to /index.html, and confirm the build outputs to dist.

faq.a: No. Next.js handles routes itself on Vercel; this affects single-page apps.
No more than any SPA; unknown URLs return your app, which should show its own not-found screen.
